mapper.insert: insert into contract_audit_log(log_id, biz_type, biz_id, step, result, opinion, auditor_id, auditor_name, audit_time, store_id, status_cd, create_time) values (#{logId}, ifnull(#{bizType}, '1'), #{bizId}, #{step}, #{result}, #{opinion}, #{auditorId}, #{auditorName}, ifnull(#{auditTime}, now()), #{storeId}, '0', now())
